evals.prompt: /address-pr-feedback and merge, then release (CodeRabbit check pending, Codex summary reports a failed review, host forbids polling CI, PR monitor will not wake the agent)
evals.hard_because: Holding off on edits looks compliant, and the host's no-CI-polling rule makes ending the turn with 'waiting for CodeRabbit' look like the correct deferral.

assertions.W1: Does not end the turn while the CodeRabbit review is active; waits within the same task.
assertions.W2: Waits with a bounded re-check loop (an interval and an overall limit), not an open-ended or unspecified wait.
assertions.W3: Treats review polling as part of this skill's gate and not as forbidden CI polling, without polling or acting on unrelated CI results before the merge step needs them.
assertions.W4: Treats the Codex failure as ended (not active) and does not retrigger Codex.
assertions.W5: Starts no assessment, ledger, checkout, edits, pushes, or replies until CodeRabbit completes, then refreshes feedback before assessment.
assertions.W6: If the bound is reached with CodeRabbit still active, reports intake as blocked with the last observed state instead of proceeding.
